subject: Insurance
title: The Genetic Testing Dilemma
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Genetic Testing Dilemma.

hook.text: If a genetic test shows you carry the BRCA cancer gene.

buildup.text: GINA bans genetic discrimination in health insurance but NOT in life insurance.

discovery.text: People with bad genetic results buy more insurance. People with good results buy less.

twist.text: Some people avoid genetic testing entirely to protect their insurance rates.

climax.text: Genetics forces a choice: know your health risk and pay more, or stay ignorant and keep cheap insurance.

punchline.text: Know your genes, pay more. Some people skip tests to keep low premiums.

quiz.question: Can US life insurers use genetic test results?
options: Yes, GINA doesn't protect life insurance
